mix.rule: per-step cumulative allocation floor((step+1)*steps*batch*share) - floor(step*steps*batch*share) S1 rows; per-sample loss weight 1.0; the batch order is shuffled per step, so the mix is the only source signal

metrics.confusion_matrix_orientation: rows = target action, columns = predicted action

label_rule.note: chosen one-hot CE only; the other 17 logits appear solely in the softmax denominator

gpu.peak_memory_note: torch.cuda.max_memory_{allocated,reserved} over this run; reset immediately before the first step

rollout_checkpoint.note: the checkpoint the beta=0.5 round-2 shards were rolled out from; it equals the WP05.5 50k B0 step-1000 checkpoint, so round 2 was collected by the beta=1.0 50k student, not by the beta=1.0 round-1 baseline

commands.step: convert 15 shards with the WP05.2 CLI
dev dry run (wiring only, both attempts)

window_alignment.training_window: the D410-S1 shards store frames[t-3..t], four consecutive game frames; one decision = two frames = two renders, so the stack is consecutive

actions.note: pooled over the arm's episodes; descriptive only

verdict.what_this_is: smoke: the v410 checkpoint ran in the real engine under the S1N dev ruler

attempt1.why: the G410-1 teacher chunk3 batch (6 concurrent teacher instances, 25 seeds) was saturating the same 20-core host; from seed 1004 on the episodes were starved and the run was stopped by the supervising agent rather than left to hang
attempt1.note: the partial 4 episodes are recorded for transparency only; they are NOT part of any statistic in this file

attempt2.gated_on: waited for teacher chunk3 pid 367018 to exit before starting, so the 20 episodes did not share the host with the teacher batch

comparison_beta1.rule: descriptive side-by-side only: same 1,000-step/128-batch/seed-0 budget, same S1 20 %/DAgger 80 % mix, same S1N dev suite and the same 20 dev seeds; no interval, no significance test, no gate, no decision rule
confounds: the beta=1.0 round-1 shards were rolled out from checkpoint 3bc0ec44... with injection_rate 1.0, while the beta=0.5 round-2 shards were rolled out from 6ebe4ea9... (the WP05.5 50k B0), so this compares 'beta=0.5 second-round data' with 'beta=1.0 first-round data': the injection coefficient and the rollout student both changed
the injection rate differs by construction (1.0 vs 0.500857)
one training seed (0) and one checkpoint per arm: no variance estimate
the beta=1.0 50k/21k wall times were measured on an idle host; this run shared the host with the G410-1 teacher chunk3 batch

not_claimed: not the 50k-decision first DAgger round: this smoke trains 1,000 steps on the six completed shards (21,000 decisions, ~42 % of the 50k target)
not a β=0.5 round: every shard here used β=1.0 (full teacher injection)
not G410-2: no confirm-split run, no 20-episode protocol, no four-arm matrix
not a development score: the offline metrics are in-sample on the exact train batches this run consumed, so they are optimisation diagnostics, not held-out skill
no new data collection and no engine run: the game is never launched by this module; the two dev episodes are a separate evaluator invocation
one model arm (B0), one seed (0), one fixed step budget (1,000): no variance estimate and no convergence claim
rows without a chosen plan are excluded, and unknown candidates are never negative labels; that rule is not a learned preference over unknowns
G410-2 (the v4.1.0 acceptance gate) -- not measured, not attempted
any significance test, confidence interval or pass/fail gate on the 20 dev episodes: the contrast with beta=1.0 is descriptive
that beta=0.5 is better or worse than beta=1.0: one arm, one seed, a different rollout student, and 0/20 clear on every side of the comparison
any RL/PPO training: B0 is behaviour cloning with chosen one-hot CE
the aborted attempt-1 episodes: they are logged but excluded from every statistic here
limits: one arm (B0), one training seed (0), 1,000 steps: no variance estimate
52,500 round-2 decisions (105 % of the 50,000 target) but still one DAgger round
offline metrics are in-sample train-batch metrics, not held-out accuracy
dev episodes are the 20 dev seeds only (1000-1019); G410-2 is not measured

wall times are not comparable with the beta=1.0 runs: a G410-1 teacher chunk3 batch (6 concurrent teacher instances) ran on the same 20-core host, load average 45-74 during training, and it terminated the first 20-episode eval
